title: An idea starts from one real story and invents the angle
description:
Every idea path today joins at least two sources and refuses invention.

```gherkin
Feature: Premise-led ideas

  Scenario: One real event, one invented angle
    Given an accepted Reference about a real event
    When satire ideas are generated
    Then each idea names the real event it comes from
    And states its invented premise separately

  Scenario: The source is not copied
    Given an idea from a Reference
    When the piece is drafted
    Then it reuses none of the source's sentences
```
